listing.name: Locked and Loaded
listing.summary: Adds over twenty unique bounties with varied rewards, challenges, and story elements to the Magic Bounty boards.
listing.aiSummary: Adds over twenty unique bounties with varied rewards, challenges, and story elements to the Magic Bounty boards.

description:
This mod adds 20+ unique bounties to the Magic Bounty boards. Some offer interesting rewards, other simply a challenge, or a bit of story to get involved with.

Download available here

Always DELETE the old version before extracting the new one

Requires MagicLib

This is a community-driven project that anyone can contribute to. If you are interested to participate and write your own bounties, you can join my

Magic Lab discord

, the

Unofficial Starsector Discord

or simply send me a message here on the forum. Documentation can be found

on the Wiki

.

I also wrote a detailed breakdown on how to write bounties on the wiki.

Why make this a separate mod instead of adding it to MagicLib directly? First because I want to separate content from function when it comes to MagicLib, and secondly to avoid the issues of constant updates making it more likely that an important one gets ignored by those not interested in the bounties.

Thanks to all the current contributors:

AlexAtheos

Avanitia

JRG

NuclearStudent

psiklaw

Swagumenium

Wisp

Bug Tracker and Feedback form

You have some feedback to share but no forum account? You can use

this form

to leave me a comment.
